name: County class
axes: right-handed: X longitudinal/bow-positive; Y up; Z transverse

reference.configuration: Kent-group County-class cruiser, US Navy 1943 recognition reference. Four twin 8-inch turrets, three thin raked funnels and a high flush-deck hull. The source distinguishes cut-down quarterdecks on Suffolk and Cumberland, which are not represented by the main outline. Wartime AA and aviation fittings differ from the catalog early fit; the artwork does not change its two scout-aircraft capability.
reference.note: Stylized class interpretation guided by catalog dimensions, armament and the linked recognition reference; not an engineering plan or exact reconstruction. Continuous hull/deck surfaces, shaped housings and round fittings are original polygon interpretations of the same documented stations.
